_comment: Pixel-wise FLIM MLE tool. AutoForm over PixelMleViewModel: an Analysis dock (CLSM + IRF file lists, parallel/perpendicular channels, fit window, IRF prep, background, engine + worker threads, Run button) plus a result dock showing the fitted lifetime (tau) map. The fit-model combo + per-model parameter rows are injected by PixelMleViewModel.view_spec (fit23/24/25); each pixel is fitted by Poisson MLE through the shared fit2x harness.

sections.title: CLSM imaging files
sections.description: Confocal (CLSM) TTTR image file(s) to analyse. Drag-drop to add.

sections.title: IRF file
sections.description: IRF TTTR measurement (the first file is used).

sections.label: Parallel channels (∥)
sections.description: Space-separated routing channels forming the parallel (VV) detection.

sections.label: Perpendicular channels (⊥)
sections.description: Space-separated routing channels forming the perpendicular (VH) detection.

sections.label: Fit start
sections.description: Fit-window start on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.label: Fit stop
sections.description: Fit-window stop on the binned micro-time axis.

sections.label: Micro-time binning
sections.description: Integer down-binning of the micro-time axis before fitting.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Pixels with fewer photons in the fit window are not fitted.

sections.label: Region
sections.description: Optional region confining the fit to part of the frame — regions saved in CLSM Draw (.json), a Cellpose segmentation (_seg.npy), a label image or a binary mask. Leave empty to fit the whole frame.

sections.label: Threshold
sections.description: Fraction of the IRF maximum below which bins are zeroed.

sections.label: Shift ∥
sections.description: Parallel-channel sub-bin IRF shift.

sections.label: Shift ⊥
sections.description: Perpendicular-channel sub-bin IRF shift.

sections.label: 2I* (P+2S)
sections.description: Optimise P+2S instead of P and S separately.

sections.label: BIFL scatter
sections.description: Reduce Istar by the background contribution.

sections.label: Subtract
sections.description: Subtract a flat background from the fit window.

sections.label: bg ∥
sections.description: Parallel background counts spread over the fit window.

sections.label: bg ⊥
sections.description: Perpendicular background counts spread over the fit window.

sections.label: Engine
sections.description: Histogram extraction: fast = vectorised C++, loop = exact bincount, auto = fast with bincount fallback on saturation.

sections.label: Threads
sections.description: Fit worker threads. 0 = auto (cpu − 1); 1 = serial.

buttons.label: ▶ Run
buttons.description: Fit every selected file pixel-by-pixel; writes <stem>_pixel_mle.csv next to each.

sections.title: Lifetime map
sections.description: Fitted single-pixel lifetime (τ) map of the selected file; the in-plot selector switches between analysed files and the z-slider scrubs frames.
